get_message_class_from_descriptor: get a proto2 message class from a descriptor using GetMessageClass
get_message_classes_for_files: get all message classes from specified proto files using GetMessageClassesForFiles
get_messages_from_file_protos: build a dictionary of all messages from FileDescriptorProtos using GetMessages
create_message_factory_with_pool: create a MessageFactory instance with a custom DescriptorPool for dynamic message creation
internal_create_message_class: internally build a proto2 message class from a descriptor using _InternalCreateMessageClass
